items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And then, I brought Laura Washington up from Birmingham later.

ctx.x: She had recorded 'Truly By The Things We Do'. That was a recording. That was a good number.
And then, I brought Laura Washington up from Birmingham later. Yeah. They both sing about the same side by the same style.
There was a 1942 movie, a 3 minute movie, an actual soundie called Hot In The Groove. A 3 minute movie. Do you remember that one?
